title: FlowTestConfig
description: Schema for .flow.test.yml files — agent-driven browser tests. The runner exposes only generic browser tools to the LLM; steps are described in natural language and the LLM reads the page (accessibility tree) to act.

target.description: Surface area being tested (chat, ide, threads, onboarding, any). Documentation hint only — does not change the toolkit exposed to the LLM.

setup.description: Named fixture commands run before each case: reset_test_file, goto:/path

backend_mode.description: Which oxy backend mode the flow exercises. 'cloud' (default) = enterprise mode, the production path: oxy start --enterprise + oxy seed of demo_project/ as the Demo workspace; the runner signs in on :3000 as flow@oxy.local and prefixes workspace paths with /local/workspaces/<demo id>. 'local' = the legacy, unmaintained --local single-workspace no-auth mode; opt in only for a flow that tests legacy local mode itself. Flows in a single invocation must agree.

act.description: Natural-language step. The LLM reads the page via browser_snapshot and chooses generic browser actions.

wait_for.description: Named wait primitive: streaming_complete, network_idle, selector:<sel>

cache_scope.description: Cache scope. 'shared' lets two flows that describe the same canonical step (e.g., a copy-pasted prelude from canonical-prompts.md) reuse a single recording. 'flow' (default) keeps the recording private to this flow/case/step.

assert.description: Deterministic assertion: 'text X visible', 'selector Y has attribute Z=W', 'tool succeeded'.

judge.description: Natural-language claim verified by LLM judge against screenshot + DOM text.
